comment: What each Seedance model version accepts, as the ByteDance2 nodes define it.
Read by backend/src/seedanceVersions.ts (which validates submissions and builds the
graph) and by src/features/generation/seedanceVersions.ts (which drives the picker),
the same way stillImagePresets.json is shared. One table so a widened range cannot
be offered by the UI and then refused by the server.
Transcribed from GET /object_info on ComfyUI 0.33.2, where the `model` input of
ByteDance2ReferenceNode / ByteDance2FirstLastFrameNode is a dynamic combo whose
selected option decides which nested inputs exist. `resolutions` lists every option
each version's combo offers, so 4K is 2.0-only and 480p is on both. 480p is the one
value the Resolution panel still flags as low for a video model -- that note is
The Fast and Mini tiers the combo also offers are deliberately absent: no Momi
workflow selects them and the credit tracker has no fitted rate for either, so a
cost shown for one would be a guess.
